fic.id, fic.search_miss_id, fic.import_run_id, fsm.query AS search_query, fsm.normalized_query, fic.status, fic.source_provider, fic.source_key, fic.source_url, fic.source_food_type, fic.name, fic.brand, fic.food_description, fic.serving_description, fic.serving_size, fic.serving_unit, fic.calories, fic.fat, fic.carbohydrate, fic.protein, fic.content_hash, fic.duplicate_food_id, fic.approved_food_id, fic.rejection_reason, fic.reviewed_by_admin_id, fic.reviewed_at, fic.created_at, fic.updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO food_search_misses ( query, normalized_query, first_user_id, last_user_id ) VALUES ( #{query}, #{normalizedQuery}, #{userId}, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (normalized_query) DO UPDATE SET query = EXCLUDED.query, miss_count = food_search_misses.miss_count + 1, last_user_id = EXCLUDED.last_user_id, last_requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = CASE WHEN food_search_misses.status IN ('FAILED', 'NO_RESULT', 'REJECTED') THEN 'PENDING' ELSE food_search_misses.status END, last_failure_reason = CASE WHEN food_search_misses.status IN ('FAILED', 'NO_RESULT', 'REJECTED') THEN NULL ELSE food_search_misses.last_failure_reason END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

SELECT
FROM food_search_misses WHERE id = #{searchMissId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM food_search_misses WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetries}) ORDER BY miss_count DESC, last_requested_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE food_search_misses SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{searchMissId} AND (status = 'PENDING' OR status = 'FAILED')
UPDATE food_search_misses SET status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{searchMissId}
UPDATE food_search_misses SET status = 'NO_RESULT', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{searchMissId}

UPDATE food_search_misses SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_failure_reason = #{failureReason}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{searchMissId}
UPDATE food_search_misses SET status = 'APPROVED', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{searchMissId}
UPDATE food_search_misses SET status = 'REJECTED', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{searchMissId}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO food_import_runs DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE food_import_runs SET status = #{status}, picked_count = #{pickedCount}, candidate_count = #{candidateCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_import_candidates ( search_miss_id, import_run_id, status, source_provider, source_key, source_url, source_food_type, name, brand, food_description, serving_description, serving_size, serving_unit, calories, fat, carbohydrate, protein, content_hash, duplicate_food_id ) VALUES ( #{candidate.searchMissId}, #{candidate.importRunId}, #{candidate.status}, #{candidate.sourceProvider}, #{candidate.sourceKey}, #{candidate.sourceUrl}, #{candidate.sourceFoodType}, #{candidate.name}, #{candidate.brand}, #{candidate.foodDescription}, #{candidate.servingDescription}, #{candidate.servingSize}, #{candidate.servingUnit}, #{candidate.calories}, #{candidate.fat}, #{candidate.carbohydrate}, #{candidate.protein}, #{candidate.contentHash}, #{candidate.duplicateFoodId} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM foods WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM foods WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} AND serving_key = COALESCE(#{servingDescription}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO foods ( source_key, source_url, name, brand, serving_description, serving_size, serving_unit, calories, fat, carbohydrate, protein, content_hash ) VALUES ( #{sourceKey}, #{sourceUrl}, #{name}, #{brand}, #{servingDescription}, #{servingSize}, #{servingUnit}, #{calories}, #{fat}, #{carbohydrate}, #{protein}, #{contentHash} ) RETURNING id

SELECT
FROM food_import_candidates fic JOIN food_search_misses fsm ON fsm.id = fic.search_miss_id WHERE fic.search_miss_id IN
#{searchMissId}
ORDER BY fic.search_miss_id, CASE fic.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'DUPLICATE' THEN 1 WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, fic.id

SELECT
FROM food_import_candidates fic JOIN food_search_misses fsm ON fsm.id = fic.search_miss_id WHERE fic.id IN
#{candidateId}
ORDER BY fic.id FOR UPDATE OF fic
mapper.update: UPDATE food_import_candidates SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_food_id = #{foodId}, reviewed_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rejection_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{candidateId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DUPLICATE')

UPDATE food_import_candidates SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_by_admin_id = #{adminId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE search_miss_id = #{searchMissId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DUPLICATE')
